description: Upgrading the quality of the Accident and Emergency Care System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As the number of emergency hospitalizations due to accidents and trauma, road accidents and severe heart attacks and strokes is increasing in Sri Lanka, the need to establish an integrated and standardized structure for the emergency response to these situations has been identified. Accordingly, it has been proposed to establish a Directorate of Accident and Emergency Care System under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media to strengthen the coordination, regulation and upgrading of these accident and emergency care services. The establishment of the said Directorate will enable the integration of emergency health services under a common structure and the systematic strengthening of clinical protocols, referral pathways and capacity building initiatives. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to establish a Directorate of Accident and Emergency Care Systems under the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.
